items.snippet: Skift Take: This is only the third nationwide ground stop in 25 years. The last one, during a 2023 system outage, lasted about two hours.

items.title: Royal Orchid Hotels Ltd. strengthens National Presence with five new hotel openings adding 426 room keys in Q2 FY27
items.snippet: Total income for consolidated Q2 FY27 was reported at Rs 116 crore in comparison to Rs 86.77 crore in Q2 FY26. EBITDA was Rs 31.66 crore compared to Rs 20.79 crore with profit after tax (after exceptional items) stood at Rs 14.73 crore compared to Rs 4.29 crore. Standalone numbers for Q2 FY27 reported total income of Rs 58.75 crore compared to 49.64 crore in Q2 FY26.

items.title: Bodhi Tree System to invest $180mn for majority stake in Chennai's Adyar Ananda Bhavan
items.snippet: Bodhi Tree System has decided to invest $180 million to acquire a controlling stake in Adyar Ananda Bhavan. This strategic investment aims to bolster the restaurant chain's reach both in domestic and international markets. Currently, A2B boasts 160 outlets across southern India and 30 international locations, including Singapore and the USA.

items.title: SFO’s Harvey Milk Terminal 1 Wins Five Design-Build Awards
items.snippet: San Francisco International Airport (SFO) has received five honours for its Harvey Milk Terminal 1 at the Design-Build Institute of America’s (DBIA) 2026 Design-Build Awards. The terminal was recognised across multiple categories, including Project of the Year, Best in Design – Architecture, Best in Leadership/Training, National Award of Excellence – Aviation and National Award of Merit – Aviation.

items.title: VisitEngland announces 2025-2026 Visitor Attraction Accolade winners
items.snippet: VisitEngland has announced the winners of its 2025–2026 Visitor Attraction Accolades . This year, 73 attractions across England received recognition. The awards celebrated excellence across five categories, highlighting the quality of the country’s visitor experiences. VisitEngland recognised 73 attractions across England.

items.title: 10 Experiences That Showcase Spectacular Boston in Winter
items.snippet: Winter in Boston offers a chance to see the city in a new way. Historic neighborhoods have a magic that seems amplified in the cold, the waterfront is filled with festivities, and the city’s restaurants and cultural attractions are an appealing counterbalance to the brisk weather. So that you can make the most of your visit, here’s how to experience a winter escape to Boston, Massachusetts.

items.title: Continent of Couture: Why African Designers Are the Talk of the Fashion World
items.snippet: African fashion is surging onto global catwalks with bold creativity, extraordinary craftsmanship and a deep-rooted heritage that’s redefining luxury.

items.title: Aspri Spirits, Flor de Caña Name Top 10 India Finalists for Sustainable Cocktail Challenge
items.snippet: Now in its 6th edition, and coinciding with Flor de Caña’s 135th anniversary, the Flor de Caña Sustainable Cocktail Challenge is a global celebration of sustainability that inspires, promotes and recognizes the world’s most talented mixologists.

items.title: Marriott International signs South Asia’s largest Courtyard by Marriott in Bengaluru
items.snippet: Marriott International has signed an agreement with Vedant Enterprises to develop Courtyard by Marriott Bengaluru Hi-Tech Defense and Aerospace Park, which is set to become the largest Courtyard by Marriott hotel in South Asia. Scheduled to open in 2030, the 350-key property will strengthen Marriott’s presence in Bengaluru’s growing business and hospitality market.
